newsitem.title: USA: Wynn's Intl to buy back 1.1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Wynn's Intl to buy back 1.1 mln shrs.

text.p: Wynn's International Inc said Wednesday it expects to purchase 1.1 million shares of its common stock from its stockholders at a price of $24.25 per share in a Dutch auction self-tender.

The company had offered to purchase for cash up to 1.1 shares, or about 8.0 percent of its outstanding common, at a purchase price, net to the seller in cash, not greater than $25 and not less than $22 per share.
About 1,597,843 shares were tendered at or below the price of $24.25 per share. The number of shares purchased from each tendering stockholder will be prorated at about 69 percent.
Before the tender offer, Wynn's had about 13.7 million shares outstanding.
